import numpy as np
def make(seed):
    r = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    cond = np.repeat([0, 1], 190)                       # 통제 190 · 개입 190
    mil = 4.83 + 0.31 * cond + r.normal(0, 1.05, 380)   # 심은 차이 = 0.31
    return mil[cond == 1].mean() - mil[cond == 0].mean()
for s in (73, 37, 2026):
    print(s, round(make(s), 2))
# 73 0.4
# 37 0.28
# 2026 0.25

diffs = [make(s) for s in range(1, 501)]
print(round(np.mean(diffs), 3), round(min(diffs), 2), round(max(diffs), 2))
# 0.303 -0.07 0.62
